title: Verity Trust Report
description: Trust Report generated by the Verity Verify engine, containing human origin determination, confidence scoring, and policy evaluation results.

report_id.description: Unique identifier for this report (UUID format)

schema_version.description: Schema version for this trust report

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the report was generated

container_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the Verity container file

engine_version.description: Version of the Verity Verify engine that generated this report

HumanOriginProof.description: Determination of whether content originated from a human-only pipeline

value.description: Human origin determination: YES (verified human origin), NO (AI involvement detected), UNAVAILABLE (cannot be determined)

has_capture_event.description: Whether a CAPTURE event exists in the provenance chain

capture_key_trusted.description: Whether the capture device key is in the trusted set

has_ai_edit_event.description: Whether any AI_EDIT event exists in the chain

event_chain_valid.description: Whether the event hash chain verified correctly

RealityConfidence.description: Probabilistic confidence score with signal breakdown

reasons.description: Individual signals that contributed to the score

limitations.description: Disclaimer about the limitations of the confidence score

ConfidenceSignal.description: Individual signal contributing to the confidence score

score_delta.description: Points added (positive) or subtracted (negative) from confidence

ContextDecision.description: Policy evaluation result for a specific workflow context

workflow.description: Name of the workflow policy that was evaluated

decision.description: Final decision: ALLOW (proceed), WARN (proceed with caution), REQUIRE_EXTRA_VERIFICATION (additional steps needed), BLOCK (do not proceed)

policy_version.description: Version of the policy that was applied

matched_rules.description: IDs of policy rules that matched

payload_hash_ok.description: Whether the payload hash matches the manifest

event_chain_ok.description: Whether the event hash chain is valid

transparency_log_ok.description: Whether the log proof verifies (null if no proof present)

errors.description: List of error messages from failed checks
